notes.title: Happy New Year! v1.35 Patch
notes.notes:
I'd like to wish everyone a fantastic year ahead and also a big thank you to the continual feedback and bug reports to help make the game better!

Heres a list of fixes in this patch v1.35:

- Reaper Mode continues past Hydra boss
- Swallow Whole description changed
- Dwarven Ghost Event prompt text updated
- Santa Event does not appear outside of Seasons mode
- Feinting Strikes description changed
- Floating Stones fix
- Multistrike via Evolve works on the same turn to match other spells
- Treasure UI duplicate stacking fixed
- Escape Screen UI duplicate stacking fixed
- Mage intro cutscene subtitles fixed
- Talents can now scroll in the Hero stat UI
- Preparation Talent fixed

notes.title: v1.34 Update
notes.notes:
v1.34 Bug fixes

Gaining power via an effect now triggers change in power effect on Jungle creatures.
Numerous UI fixes and improvements
Flarestone Shards now shown
Healing Potions in map fixed
Karim Kingpries wont prevent Wyrmfoot Legionaire from spawning
Rogue decks swapped
Scaled Defence on Core Hydra fixed

notes.title: Seasons mode - bug fix
notes.notes: Thanks to some sharp eyes from the community, the naughty and nice cards are now being saved in your deck again!

notes.title: UI, Translation and Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Over the launch period I'd like to thank every player for giving us their feedback on shaping the game to become what it is today!

We've now got multiple languages and and even smoother experience thanks to the tireless efforts of the team and our dedicated playerbase!

So once again thankyou, and keep on letting us know what you think!

notes.title: 3rd Allegiance & 4th Floor Release!
notes.notes:
DungeonTop is now in full release! We wish to celebrate with players for reaching this milestone. There are now over 800 playable cards and a 4th dungeon floor!

Thank you for being part of our amazing journey into the dungeon. It's been quite the journey, with plenty of twists and turns to make it interesting!

I'd like to personally invite anyone to participate in the forums and let us know what your experience is like! Of course we'll be listening!

notes.title: v1.24 Loot changes & Variable Talents
notes.notes:
New talents to choose from randomly drawn as you level related to your hero class
Loot drops are always shown, flarestones used to make additional picks
Dungeon Ferocity levels 6, 7 and 8 added
Ignite keyword replaces Burn
Various random event tweaks, and now non repeating
Various UI improvements
Leaving a dungeon floor occurs by choice, not automatically anymore
Defeating a boss heals your hero 75%
Removed Negation Stone event
Many card balances including Fire Titan, Static Pylon, Lizard Matriarch, Repeating Fireblast, Soul Spear, Powershot

Fixes:
Tarboy level 1,2,3
Shove
Shadowraiser
Explosive Mad Contraption
Whitewood Staff
Chain keyword effect
Enemy heroes retaliating when dead
